def transform(grid):
    # Copy the non-background pattern in the populated compartment to every
    # blank compartment separated by color-4 lines.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Components are rectangles split by full horizontal/vertical separator lines.
    hs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 4 for x in row)]
    vs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    # separator bars may be interrupted by horizontal bars; find vertical bars
    # from columns predominantly 4, excluding row separators.
    vs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h)) >= h-1]
    rbounds = [-1] + hs + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vs + [w]
    regions=[]
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
      r0,r1=rbounds[ri]+1,rbounds[ri+1]
      if r0>=r1: continue
      for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
        c0,c1=cbounds[ci]+1,cbounds[ci+1]
        if c0>=c1: continue
        regions.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    source=None
    for reg in regions:
      r0,r1,c0,c1=reg
      if any(grid[r][c]!=9 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
        source=reg;break
    if source is None: return grid
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=source
    pat=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
      if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==source: continue
      if r1-r0==len(pat) and c1-c0==len(pat[0]):
        for i in range(r1-r0): out[r0+i][c0:c1]=pat[i][:]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the populated compartment's motif into matching blank compartments."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full color-4 rows and columns form the compartment boundaries.
    hs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 4 for x in row)]
    vs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h)) >= h - 1]
    rbounds = [-1] + hs + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vs + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri] + 1, rbounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(cbounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci] + 1, cbounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 < c1:
                regions.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    source = next((reg for reg in regions
                   if any(grid[r][c] != 9
                          for r in range(reg[0], reg[1])
                          for c in range(reg[2], reg[3]))), None)
    if source is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    pattern = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        if (r0, r1, c0, c1) == source:
            continue
        if r1 - r0 == len(pattern) and c1 - c0 == len(pattern[0]):
            for i in range(len(pattern)):
                out[r0 + i][c0:c1] = pattern[i][:]
    return out
